verdict.rationale: Swell documents its own event-driven mechanism: webhooks subscribe to model events and call a URL when an event occurs, and models can define lifecycle events. Serverless functions add custom logic. The evidence does not show a rule definition layer with conditions mapped to actions, and does not explicitly tie functions to event triggers. Missing for 10: a documented rules or conditions engine for event-to-action automation, explicit event-triggered function execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks can be configured to call a URL when a particular event occurs, enabling outgoing calls to external services.
Webhooks enable real-time communication between the Swell platform and external services, by subscribing to any number of model events.
Swell generates the REST resource from it—fields, validation, relationships and lifecycle events, with no endpoint code to write.
Deploy serverless functions to customize logic and connect to external APIs.
